newFeatures.title: Claude app sessions on the board
newFeatures.detail: See local Code sessions from the Claude desktop app in a folder-based Claude App column. Go to session opens the matching session and brings Claude forward.

newFeatures.title: cmux session support
newFeatures.detail: See cmux sessions together by folder. Go to session selects the matching workspace and terminal surface, then brings cmux forward.

newFeatures.title: Update from the Spyhop menu
newFeatures.detail: Choose Check for Updates… to review a new version’s complete release notes. Update and restart installs it and reopens Spyhop automatically.

newFeatures.title: Release notes after each update
newFeatures.detail: The version you just installed introduces all of its New Features and Fixes once. Release Notes in the Spyhop menu opens the latest published notes.

fixes.title: Orca folder workspaces get their own columns
fixes.detail: Sessions in Orca workspaces made from a folder now appear under that workspace's name, instead of all sharing one unnamed column.

fixes.title: Close update windows by clicking outside
fixes.detail: Update available and What's new close when you click outside them, like other windows on the board. They stay open while an update is being prepared.

fixes.title: Orca sessions with the Orca app from the DMG
fixes.detail: Spyhop now finds the Orca CLI inside Orca.app, so sessions in Orca show up even when the CLI is not registered. If Orca still cannot be reached, those sessions appear as regular terminal cards instead of disappearing.

fixes.title: What's new appears once
fixes.detail: This window counts as seen as soon as it opens, so it does not come back on the next launch if you quit Spyhop without closing it.
